docs.title: Welcome to LeftWM Dotfiles
docs.text: This is my personal LeftWM configuration for Arch Linux running on X11.

docs.title: What's Included
docs.text:
• LeftWM - Dynamic tiling window manager
  • Polybar - Floating status bar with custom modules
  • Rofi - Application launcher with custom theme
  • slock - Simple screen locker
  • nm-applet - Network manager system tray

docs.title: Color Scheme
docs.text:
• Border: #C36C0F (Amber)
  • Text: #ED9381 (Coral)
  • Background: #0a0a0a (Deep Black)
  • Highlight: #FFB86C (Light Amber)

docs.title: Installation Guide
docs.text: This guide will help you set up my LeftWM configuration on your Arch Linux system.

docs.title: 1. Prerequisites
docs.text:
Ensure you have the following packages installed. You can install them via pacman or your preferred AUR helper (like paru or yay):

```bash

docs.title: Window Manager & Bar
docs.text: sudo pacman -S polybar trizen -S leftwm

docs.title: Utilities & Menu
docs.text: sudo pacman -S rofi feh slock network-manager-applet

docs.title: Fonts (Required for icons and text)
docs.text: sudo pacman -S ttf-font-awesome noto-fonts

docs.title: Note: Ensure you have 'Z003 Bold Italic' installed (often available via AUR or manual install)
docs.text: git clone https://github.com/WgpArch/leftwm.git ~/.dotfiles/leftwm cd ~/.dotfiles/leftwm

docs.title: Link LeftWM configs
docs.text: ln -sf ~/.dotfiles/leftwm/configs/leftwm/config.ron ~/.config/leftwm/config.ron ln -sf ~/.dotfiles/leftwm/configs/leftwm/rofi ~/.config/leftwm/rofi

docs.title: Link Polybar configs
docs.text: ln -sf ~/.dotfiles/leftwm/configs/polybar/leftwm ~/.config/polybar1

docs.title: Create the theme symlink (Crucial for LeftWM to find the up script and theme.toml)
docs.text:
mkdir -p ~/.config/leftwm/themes ln -sf ~/.dotfiles/leftwm/configs/leftwm ~/.config/leftwm/themes/cyberpunk ln -sf ~/.config/leftwm/themes/cyberpunk ~/.config/leftwm/themes/current

Set permissions chmod +x ~/.config/leftwm/themes/current/up chmod +x ~/.config/leftwm/rofi/powermenu.sh chmod +x ~/.config/polybar1/launch.sh chmod +x ~/.config/polybar1/click_weather.sh chmod +x ~/.config/polybar1/click_calendar.sh chmod +x ~/.config/polybar1/weather.py chmod +x ~/.config/polybar1/polybar_calendar.py

docs.title: Keybinds Reference
docs.text: All keybinds use Mod4 (the Super / Windows key) as the primary modifier.

docs.title: 🚀 Applications & System
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + p Open Rofi Application Launcher Mod4 + Shift + Return Open Terminal (lxterminal) Mod4 + Shift + q Close focused window Mod4 + Shift + r Soft Reload LeftWM & Polybar Mod4 + Shift + x Log out / Kill session Mod4 + Ctrl + l Lock screen (slock) Print Take a screenshot (3-second delay)

docs.title: 🪟 Window Management
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + Return Move focused window to top of stack Mod4 + Shift + k Move focused window up in stack Mod4 + Shift + j Move focused window down in stack Mod4 + Shift + Up Move focused window up (arrow keys) Mod4 + Shift + Down Move focused window down (arrow keys)

docs.title: 🎯 Focus & Navigation
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + k Focus window up Mod4 + j Focus window down Mod4 + Up Focus window up (arrow keys) Mod4 + Down Focus window down (arrow keys) Mod4 + l Focus next workspace Mod4 + h Focus previous workspace Mod4 + Right Focus next workspace (arrow keys) Mod4 + Left Focus previous workspace (arrow keys) Mod4 + w Swap tags Mod4 + Shift + w Move window to last workspace

docs.title: 📐 Layouts
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + Ctrl + k Next layout Mod4 + Ctrl + j Previous layout Mod4 + Ctrl + Up Next layout (arrow keys) Mod4 + Ctrl + Down Previous layout (arrow keys)

docs.title: 🔢 Tags (Workspaces)
docs.text:
Note: LeftWM is configured with 15 tags in this setup.

Keybind Action Mod4 + [1-9, 0, F1, F2] Go to specific tag Mod4 + Shift + [1-9, 0, F1, F2] Move focused window to specific tag

docs.title: Polybar Configuration
docs.text: The status bar is handled by Polybar, configured to float at the top of the screen with rounded corners. The configuration files are located in ~/.config/polybar1/.

docs.title: 📐 Layout
docs.text:
The bar is divided into three distinct sections:

  • Left: Arch Linux launcher icon (triggers Rofi) and the system tray (nm-applet).
  • Center: 15 Workspaces (Tags), Date/Time, and a live Weather module.
  • Right: System statistics (Memory, CPU, Temperature, Filesystem) and a Power menu icon.

docs.title: 🖱️ Click Handlers & Rofi Menus
docs.text:
Several modules are interactive and launch custom Rofi menus styled with the cyberpunk theme:

  • Launcher (Mod4 + p or click the Arch icon): Opens the application launcher.
  • Weather: Clicking the weather module opens a detailed forecast window.
  • Calendar: Clicking the clock opens a monthly calendar view.
  • Power Menu: Clicking the power icon opens a menu to Lock, Logout, Reboot, Shutdown, or Suspend.

docs.title: ⚙️ Scripts
docs.text: All custom scripts are located in ~/.config/polybar1/: * launch.sh: Safely kills existing instances and launches the bar. * weather.py: Fetches weather data from wttr.in. * polybar_calendar.py: Generates the calendar text. * click_*.sh: Shell scripts that pipe the Python script outputs into Rofi.

docs.title: Look & Feel (Theming)
docs.text: The entire setup revolves around a "Cyberpunk Taxi" aesthetic, utilizing a warm amber and coral color palette against a deep black background.

docs.title: 🎨 Color Palette
docs.text: Role Hex Code Description Border #C36C0F Rich Amber (Used for Polybar borders, Rofi borders, and selected items) Text #ED9381 Soft Coral (Primary text color for high readability) Background #0a0a0a Deep Black (Base background) Highlight #FFB86C Light Amber (Used for active workspaces and secondary text)

docs.title: 🪟 Rofi Theme
docs.text:
The Rofi menus use a heavily customized version of the fancy2 theme (~/.config/leftwm/rofi/fancy2.rasi).

Key Features: * Background Image: The Taxigirl_resized.jpg image is applied directly to the Rofi window background. * Transparency: The mainbox is set to transparent so the wallpaper bleeds through the menu items. * Rounded Corners: Both the main window and the selected elements feature rounded corners (border-radius: 12px and 6px respectively).

docs.title: 🖼️ Wallpaper
docs.text: The desktop wallpaper is set using feh via the LeftWM up script. * Original Image: ~/Pictures/ALNW/Taxigirl.jpg (Used for the desktop background). * Resized Image: ~/Pictures/ALNW/Taxigirl_resized.jpg (Cropped and scaled specifically to fit the Rofi window dimensions without tiling).
